text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking on Tuesdays, between the hours of 9:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., on both sides of Timberlane Drive, between the east end of the street and a point 37 metres west. The proposed parking prohibition on Timberlane Drive will assist Solid Waste Management's vehicles manoeuvering at the end of the street on garbage/recycling pick-up days and will minimize the impact to residents.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Tuesdays, on both sides of Timberlane Drive, between the east end of the street and a point 37 metres west.
